yate tadā bhavaty eka-agram ity ato na pratyartha-niyatam / Yo'pi sadṛśa-pratyaya-
pravāhena
727 cittam eka-agraṃ manyate tasya–ekāgratā yadi pravāha-cittasya dharmas tadā
728–
ekaṃ na–asti pravāha-cittaṃ
729 kṣaṇikatvāt / Atha pravāha-aṃśasya–eva pratyayasya dharmaḥ
sa
730 sarvaḥ sadṛśa-pratyaya-pravāhī vā
731 visadṛśa-pratyaya-pravāhī
732 vā pratyartha-
niyatatvād eka-agra eva–iti vikṣipta-citta-anupapattiḥ
733 / Tasmād ekam aneka-artham
avasthitaṃ cittam iti / Yadi ca cittena–ekena–ananvitāḥ svabhāva-bhinnāḥ pratyayā jāyerann
atha
734 katham anya-pratyaya-dṛṣṭasya–anyaḥ smartā bhavet / Anya-pratyaya-upacitasya ca
karma-āśayasya–anyaḥ pratyupabhoktā bhavet
735 / Kathaṃ cit
736 samādhīyamānam apy etad
737
gomaya-pāyasīya-nyāyam ākṣipati / Ki
